title: Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish Chiefs Meet Iran's Leaders in Tehran
dek: The Mecca pact states and Iran agree to keep talking; sources tell The National the talks produced no deal on the Houthis or Hormuz.
body: First high-level contact since the August Mecca defence pact. All four agreed to keep talking; no deal on the Houthis or Hormuz.

panels.label: Tehran Says
panels.text: Rezaei calls the talks “very good” and says regional states, not outside powers, should secure the region; Iran wants the US blockade lifted.

panels.label: Washington Says
panels.text: Vance says Iran must cut nuclear enrichment to end the war; Trump says he and Netanyahu must “finish the job,” Channel 12 reports.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Tehran speaks of regional security, Washington of finishing the job; beneath both is who sets the terms for reopening Hormuz.
